messages:
Alex: DevOpsBot paging us: several nodes in eu-central-2-hbm are crashing during model warmup, high paging and OOMs reported. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/6132467890

DevOpsBot: ALERT: pool=eu-central-2-hbm crashloop_count=7, OOM_kills=12 in 15m. Affected artifacts: embedder-pro-v1, redwood-qa-llm.

Morgan: Im taking this. First look: container logs show repeated deserialization errors and a JIT compile timeout before the OOMs. Kernel dmesg includes "Out of memory: Kill process" and a GPU reset on some hosts.

Lee: Which nodes specifically? Ill check node health.

Morgan: nodes: ec2-euc2-128-07, ec2-euc2-128-09, ec2-euc2-128-15. Crashloops mostly on 07 and 09.

Tanya: sample log from node ec2-euc2-128-07 (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T08:11:02Z warmup.go:421: artifact load: deserialization error: unexpected EOF while reading weights
2026-03-15T08:11:03Z compile.go:88: compile step timeout after 120s for model redwood-qa-llm
2026-03-15T08:11:04Z runtime.go:210: cuda: driver-panic detected, gpu reset
2026-03-15T08:11:05Z containerd: container exited status 137 (OOM)
```

Lee: Thanks. "unexpected EOF" + checksum mismatch patterns we've seen before when artifact downloads get truncated mid-transfer. Could be S3 mirror or node disk corruption.

Morgan: Mitigation plan: 1) throttle warmup concurrency on pool to 1 2) disable kv-cache preload and JIT compile during warmup for affected models 3) fail traffic to fallback CPU model pool for in-flight requests 4) validate and re-sync artifacts from S3 mirror to local nodes.

Alex: Do it. Apply conservative limits and pause autoscaling for the pool. Also notify CS of potential customer impact.

BuildBot: ACTION: pool update initiated by Morgan: concurrency=1 autoscale=disabled

Tanya: Applying runtime overrides for affected models: WARMUP_KV_PRELOAD=false, COMPILE_IN_WARMUP=false. Command:
```
rdctl model update embedder-pro-v1 --set WARMUP_KV_PRELOAD=false --set COMPILE_IN_WARMUP=false
rdctl model update redwood-qa-llm --set WARMUP_KV_PRELOAD=false --set COMPILE_IN_WARMUP=false
```

Morgan: Starting artifact validation on node-07 now. Command:
```
artifacts verify --path /mnt/artifacts/embedder-pro-v1 --checksum-file /var/sha256sums.txt
```

Infra: I see partial files on node-07. Disk showed IO errors earlier. Spinning up a replacement host and starting a fresh artifact sync to it.

Lee: Im cordoning node-07 and 09, draining traffic and marking for reimage. Node-15 still healthy for limited capacity.

CustomerSuccess: Were seeing elevated 5xx rates for embedding endpoints from three paying customers: CS-10021, CS-10022, CS-10023. Notifying customers: sending brief outage notice and mitigation ETA 90m.

Morgan: For immediate customer experience, enable per-request fallback_model substitution: fallback_model=embedder-pro-cpu. That will trade latency for success.

BuildBot: ROUTING CHANGE: fallback_model=embedder-pro-cpu applied to pool eu-central-2-hbm

Tanya: After disabling compile_in_warmup on a canary node (ec2-euc2-128-15) warmup completed without OOM and no compile timeout. Early signal looks good.

Morgan: Good. Proceed with reimaging 07 then 09 sequentially. Infra please ensure GPU driver installed from vetted package and run driver self-check before returning to pool.

Infra: Reimage started for node-07. Installing NVIDIA driver v525.85 and running diagnostics.

Lee: Note for postmortem: add runtime-side checksum validation at artifact load time to reject truncated files before allocation. Opening a ticket now.

Morgan: Filed follow-up: https://tracker.redwood/INC-6298 - "artifact-validate-on-load" assigned to Eng-ML.

Tanya: Also seeing some artifacts show mismatched SHA256 in our mirror; coordinating with storage team to investigate S3 multipart uploads and mirror consistency.

Infra: node-07 back healthy after reimage and artifact sync. Warmup completed on node-07 with runtime overrides in place. Monitoring.

CustomerSuccess: One customer (CS-10022) confirmed reduced 5xx after fallback routing; latency increased but acceptable. Others acknowledged.

Morgan: Alarms cleared for crashloop_count and OOM_kills on pool at 6132468360. Still keeping autoscale disabled and concurrency=1 until next handoff.

Lee: Reimage scheduled for node-09 at 6132468400 (sequential).

Morgan: Handoff notes to next on-call (Lee): reimage node-09 if still flagged, validate driver version on all pool nodes, ensure artifact checksums match mirror, keep fallback_model active for 2 hours, then incrementally restore concurrency.

Alex: Post-incident action items (assign):
- Eng-ML: implement artifact load-time checksum verification (INC-6298)
- Storage: investigate mirror/integrity of S3 multipart (assigned to Infra)
- Runtime: add an automated canary that toggles COMPILE_IN_WARMUP for new model versions (assigned to DevExp)
- Runbook: add paging + artifact-corruption flow for on-call (Tanya)

CustomerSuccess: Customers notified with update; CS cases: CS-10021, CS-10022, CS-10023.

BuildBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: alarms cleared and mitigation active. (closed by Morgan)

Morgan: Handoff to Lee in 20m. Marking thread for follow-up and postmortem. Thanks team. :pray:
